args.role: Turn a specific, current buyer-authored purchasing request into a small, verifiable work sample when the published scope, submission route and acceptance conditions fit available tools. Track buyer demand, delivery, order acceptance and verified settlement separately.

description: The treasury has CAD 0 in verified available funds and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available as unverified interpretations. Zero classified requests and five unclassified sources leave demand unknown, and the catalogue pilot still needs an authorized send-or-decline decision. Advance the existing catalogue inquiry walkthrough and test one independent route tied to a buyer’s published purchasing request. Revisit the catalogue pilot after an operator decision or an eligible inbound request. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.
